pvs_title: Establishes The Andy Griffith Show as the State TV Show
evidence: PVS lists the House vote of April 16, 2025 (Bill Passed, 96-14; PVS bill 39896, vote 108719) under HB 636, which is Promoting Wholesome Content for Students (https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H636); the other HB 636 row of that date (PVS bill 39901) is correct. The bill text PVS attaches to the vote (https://static.votesmart.org/static/billtext/108719.pdf) is House Bill 557, The Andy Griffith Show as State TV Show, which is HB0557 in NC_Bill_Details_2025_2026.csv.
